terms.label: Agent
terms.comment: An agent (eg. person, group, software or physical artifact).

terms.label: Document
terms.comment: A document.

terms.label: Group
terms.comment: A class of Agents.

terms.label: Image
terms.comment: An image.

terms.label: Label Property
terms.comment: A foaf:LabelProperty is any RDF property with texual values that serve as labels.

terms.label: Online Account
terms.comment: An online account.

terms.label: Online Chat Account
terms.comment: An online chat account.

terms.label: Online E-commerce Account
terms.comment: An online e-commerce account.

terms.label: Online Gaming Account
terms.comment: An online gaming account.

terms.label: Organization
terms.comment: An organization.

terms.label: Person
terms.comment: A person.

terms.label: PersonalProfileDocument
terms.comment: A personal profile RDF document.

terms.label: Project
terms.comment: A project (a collective endeavour of some kind).

terms.label: account
terms.comment: Indicates an account held by this agent.

terms.label: account name
terms.comment: Indicates the name (identifier) associated with this online account.

terms.label: account service homepage
terms.comment: Indicates a homepage of the service provide for this online account.

terms.label: age
terms.comment: The age in years of some agent.

terms.label: AIM chat ID
terms.comment: An AIM chat ID

terms.label: based near
terms.comment: A location that something is based near, for some broadly human notion of near.

terms.label: birthday
terms.comment: The birthday of this Agent, represented in mm-dd string form, eg. '12-31'.

terms.label: current project
terms.comment: A current project this person works on.

terms.label: depiction
terms.comment: A depiction of some thing.

terms.label: depicts
terms.comment: A thing depicted in this representation.

terms.label: DNA checksum
terms.comment: A checksum for the DNA of some thing. Joke.

terms.label: familyName
terms.comment: The family name of some person.

terms.label: family_name
terms.comment: The family name of some person.

terms.label: firstName
terms.comment: The first name of a person.

terms.label: focus
terms.comment: The underlying or 'focal' entity associated with some SKOS-described concept.

terms.label: funded by
terms.comment: An organization funding a project or person.

terms.label: geekcode
terms.comment: A textual geekcode for this person, see http://www.geekcode.com/geek.html

terms.label: gender
terms.comment: The gender of this Agent (typically but not necessarily 'male' or 'female').

terms.label: Given name
terms.comment: The given name of some person.

terms.label: Given name
terms.comment: The given name of some person.

terms.label: account
terms.comment: Indicates an account held by this agent.

terms.label: homepage
terms.comment: A homepage for some thing.

terms.label: ICQ chat ID
terms.comment: An ICQ chat ID

terms.label: image
terms.comment: An image that can be used to represent some thing (ie. those depictions which are particularly representative of something, eg. one's photo on a homepage).

terms.label: interest
terms.comment: A page about a topic of interest to this person.

terms.label: is primary topic of
terms.comment: A document that this thing is the primary topic of.

terms.label: jabber ID
terms.comment: A jabber ID for something.

terms.label: knows
terms.comment: A person known by this person (indicating some level of reciprocated interaction between the parties).

terms.label: lastName
terms.comment: The last name of a person.

terms.label: logo
terms.comment: A logo representing some thing.

terms.label: made
terms.comment: Something that was made by this agent.

terms.label: maker
terms.comment: An agent that made this thing.

terms.label: personal mailbox
terms.comment: A personal mailbox, ie. an Internet mailbox associated with exactly one owner, the first owner of this mailbox. This is a 'static inverse functional property', in that there is (across time and change) at most one individual that ever has any particular value for foaf:mbox.

terms.label: sha1sum of a personal mailbox URI name
terms.comment: The sha1sum of the URI of an Internet mailbox associated with exactly one owner, the first owner of the mailbox.

terms.label: member
terms.comment: Indicates a member of a Group

terms.label: membershipClass
terms.comment: Indicates the class of individuals that are a member of a Group

terms.label: MSN chat ID
terms.comment: An MSN chat ID

terms.label: myersBriggs
terms.comment: A Myers Briggs (MBTI) personality classification.

terms.label: name
terms.comment: A name for some thing.

terms.label: nickname
terms.comment: A short informal nickname characterising an agent (includes login identifiers, IRC and other chat nicknames).

terms.label: openid
terms.comment: An OpenID for an Agent.

terms.label: page
terms.comment: A page or document about this thing.

terms.label: past project
terms.comment: A project this person has previously worked on.

terms.label: phone
terms.comment: A phone, specified using fully qualified tel: URI scheme (refs: http://www.w3.org/Addressing/schemes.html#tel).

terms.label: plan
terms.comment: A .plan comment, in the tradition of finger and '.plan' files.

terms.label: primary topic
terms.comment: The primary topic of some page or document.

terms.label: publications
terms.comment: A link to the publications of this person.

terms.label: schoolHomepage
terms.comment: A homepage of a school attended by the person.

terms.label: sha1sum (hex)
terms.comment: A sha1sum hash, in hex.

terms.label: Skype ID
terms.comment: A Skype ID

terms.label: status
terms.comment: A string expressing what the user is happy for the general public (normally) to know about their current activity.

terms.label: Surname
terms.comment: The surname of some person.

terms.label: theme
terms.comment: A theme.

terms.label: thumbnail
terms.comment: A derived thumbnail image.

terms.label: tipjar
terms.comment: A tipjar document for this agent, describing means for payment and reward.

terms.label: title
terms.comment: Title (Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr. etc)

terms.label: topic
terms.comment: A topic of some page or document.

terms.label: topic_interest
terms.comment: A thing of interest to this person.

terms.label: weblog
terms.comment: A weblog of some thing (whether person, group, company etc.).

terms.label: work info homepage
terms.comment: A work info homepage of some person; a page about their work for some organization.

terms.label: workplace homepage
terms.comment: A workplace homepage of some person; the homepage of an organization they work for.

terms.label: Yahoo chat ID
terms.comment: A Yahoo chat ID
